info.name: Salesforce Sales Cloud Salesforce Analytics REST Change Events Report Instances API
Salesforce Sales Cloud List report instances

params.name: reportId
params.description: The 15 or 18 character Salesforce report ID

items.docs: Returns a list of instances for the specified report that have been run asynchronously. Each instance includes the status and completion date.

info.name: Salesforce Sales Cloud Run a report asynchronously

params.name: reportId
params.description: The 15 or 18 character Salesforce report ID

items.docs: Runs a report asynchronously. Returns the report instance ID which can be used to retrieve the results when the report has finished running.

info.name: Salesforce Sales Cloud Get report instance results

params.name: reportId
params.description: The 15 or 18 character Salesforce report ID

params.name: instanceId
params.description: The ID of the report instance

items.docs: Retrieves the results of an asynchronous report run using the instance ID. If the report is still running, the status is returned instead of results.
